content.title: Dhurandhar 2 Box Office Collection: Ranveer Singh Film Crosses Rs 900 Crore Globally In Six Days
content.text: Spy action thriller 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' has emerged as one of the biggest blockbusters of the year, crossing the Rs 900-crore mark globally. Its India net collections crossed Rs 575 crore on Tuesday, March 24. The Ranveer Singh-starrer clocked Rs 56.55 crore in India net revenue on Tuesday from 20,412 screenings. Its domestic net tally now stands at Rs 575.67 crore, while gross collections have reached Rs 687.43 crore, according to Sacnilk. The film's worldwide earnings have climbed to Rs 919 crore, with Rs 231.57 crore contributed by overseas territories.The film also edged past the global earnings of 'Kantara: Chapter 1' (Rs 852.36 crore) and 'Stree 2' (Rs 857.15 crore) during the day, marking a significant milestone in its box-office journey. With momentum firmly on its side, it could also outstrip the domestic net collections of 'Stree 2' (Rs 597.99 crore) and 'Chhaava' (Rs 601.54 crore) as early as Wednesday, securing a place among the Top 10 highest earners in India.ALSO READ: Mukesh Chhabra Addresses Viral Lookalikes In Dhurandhar 2's 'Peak-Detailing' CastDhurandhar 2 Box Office Collection News: Hindi VersionOn the sixth day, Hindi maintained a commanding lead, with net collections of Rs 52 crore from 17,910 shows and an occupancy of 36.7%. Telugu ranked second, collecting Rs 3.10 crore from 1,404 shows and recording a healthy 43% occupancy. The Tamil version delivered Rs 1.10 crore from 903 shows at 27% occupancy. Kannada, despite its small footprint of 69 shows, impressed with a 48% occupancy and Rs 20 lakh in earnings. Malayalam generated Rs 15 lakh from 126 shows, with occupancy at 34%.As per Sacnilk data, the film set the tone early with Rs 43 crore on Day 0 from previews. It followed this with a blockbuster opening of Rs 102.55 crore on March 19. Day 2 brought in Rs 80.72 crore, while the weekend delivered a major boost: Rs 113 crore on Day 3 and Rs 114.85 crore on Day 4. Even after the usual weekday dip, the film posted a solid Rs 65 crore on Monday (Day 5).Released on March 19, 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' features Ranveer Singh as Jaskirat Singh Rangi, also known as Hamza Ali Mazari, and weaves a personal tale of vengeance into a backdrop of real-world events such as the 26/11 attacks and India's 2016 demonetisation drive. The narrative tracks Hamza's mission as he penetrates the upper echelons of the city's criminal and political networks to bring down terror operations from the inside.ALSO READ: 'How Dare You...': Did Dhurandhar 2 Storm Force Project Hail Mary To Postpone India Release?
